title: Arbitrary two-adic totient pulse blocks and exact carry transfer

concepts.label: totient divisor pulse producer
concepts.note: A CRT-Dirichlet prime with prescribed power-of-two divisibility across a preceding block.

concepts.label: delta-totient half-turn pulse block
concepts.note: A zero prefix modulo 2^K followed by the unique order-two residue.

concepts.label: window half-turn transfer
concepts.note: The exact half-modulus discrepancy created by the pulse block.

concepts.label: cofinal integral-tail half pulses
concepts.note: The consequence of combining eventual tail integrality with the arithmetic pulse producer.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CRT-DIRICHLET PRODUCER: for H,K,B with 2<=K<H, there is a prime p beyond B and H+K such that p is congruent to 1+2^(K-1) modulo 2^K, 2^K divides phi(p+H), and for every 1<=j<K it divides both phi(p-j) and phi(p-j+H).
statement_nodes.engine: Fresh primes congruent to one modulo 2^K, a finite Chinese-remainder system for the terminal and preceding positions, and Dirichlet's theorem in the resulting coprime progression.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean-checked project arithmetic producer; no external priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem prescribes divisibility data for one finite block. It does not assert that the resulting discrepancy lies in a certificate's central arc.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PULSE BLOCK: for H,K,B with 2<=K<H, there is a prime p beyond B and H+K such that deltaTotient H p is congruent to 2^(K-1) modulo 2^K, while deltaTotient H (p-j) vanishes modulo 2^K for every 1<=j<K.
statement_nodes.engine: Rewrite the divisor producer in deltaTotient coordinates, using phi(p)=p-1 and the fact that the negative half-turn equals itself modulo 2^K.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Direct Lean-checked transport of the stronger divisor data into the desired pulse coordinates.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The pulse is an exact congruence statement, not a certified kill. Its prime position is necessarily large relative to the modulus scale.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED EXACT WINDOW TRANSFER: if 2<=K<=p, the terminal deltaTotient H p is 2^(K-1) modulo 2^K, and the preceding K-1 deltaTotient letters vanish modulo 2^K, then windowDiscrepancy H (p-K) K is congruent to 2^(K-1) modulo 2^K.
statement_nodes.engine: The discrepancy recurrence doubles the zero prefix and then appends the terminal half-turn.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Finite recurrence transport of the pulse congruences.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Landing at the centre of the residue circle is not enough to fire a certified kill: the certificate radius also grows with p, H, and K.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL CONSEQUENCE: for 2<=K<H, if every H-shifted totient-tail difference is integral from N0 onward, then beyond every B there is a prime p and an integer representative z of totientTail (p+H)-totientTail p with z congruent to 2^(K-1) modulo 2^K.
open_antecedents: Eventual integrality of every H-shifted totient-tail difference from N0 onward.
statement_nodes.engine: Choose a pulse prime beyond both B and N0+K, then transfer the length-K discrepancy congruence through the integral carry recurrence.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean-checked consequence of the arithmetic pulse producer under the rationality-side integrality hypothesis.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is compatible with eventual integrality and produces no contradiction. It diagnoses the modular shape of the rational branch; it does not prove irrationality or a central-arc certificate.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The deltaTotient congruences are obtained by subtracting the divisor-controlled endpoint totients from the prime totient.
The finite discrepancy recurrence transports the produced zero-prefix and terminal-pulse letters into the same half-turn residue.
Under eventual integrality, the carry recurrence transfers the window half-turn to an actual integer tail-difference representative.
